problem.title: Manual prospecting doesn't scale. And generic scrapers stop at 120.
problem.subtitle: If you've ever hunted for clients on Google Maps, these pains ring true:

pains.title: The invisible 120 ceiling
pains.text: You scroll to the very end and Maps stops delivering. A capital city has thousands of barbershops, clinics and restaurants — the search returns a handful.

pains.title: Lists with no priority
pains.text: A thousand CSV rows full of businesses that already have websites, wrong phones and zero filtering. Your team wastes hours figuring out who is worth contacting.

pains.title: Blocks at the worst time
pains.text: Tool too aggressive, CAPTCHA shows up, the workday stops. Without resumability, everything that was meant to be collected is lost.

problem.solutionTitle: The solution: recursive grid + classification + humanization
problem.solutionText: Play Google Scraper splits the map into ~3 km cells (Quadtree). A full cell — 100+ results — is split into 4, recursively, until the region is exhausted, with global dedup by place_id and CID. On the server, every lead gets a 0–100 heat_score, and the “no website” filter lifts whoever has no real presence of their own: the perfect lead for anyone selling websites.
solutionBullets: Recursive Quadtree: from ~120 to thousands of leads per city
Global dedup by place_id and CID — zero duplicates

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before firing up the engine.

items.q: Doesn't Google Maps really cap at ~120 results?
items.a: It caps per query — no matter how much you scroll. So we split the region into ~3 km cells and scrape each one; any cell with 100+ results is split into 4, recursively. In practice, a capital city yields thousands of unique businesses, deduplicated by place_id and CID.

items.q: Is this allowed? What about LGPD/GDPR?
items.a: We only collect public business data from Google Maps. The product ships with compliance controls: automatic opt-out in messages, per-tenant suppression lists, and export/deletion of your data. How you use it is your responsibility — our Terms make that explicit, and following LGPD/GDPR in commercial outreach is the prospector's obligation.

items.q: Do I need to keep my browser open?
items.a: Yes — collection runs in your Chrome extension, in your real browser. That's exactly what makes it stable and low-profile: it's not an unknown headless server, it's your Chrome, your profile, your pace.

items.q: How many leads per hour can I get?
items.a: It depends on the mode: Stealth ~250/h, Moderate ~700/h (default), Fast ~1,800/h and Turbo ~4,000/h. For new accounts we recommend starting on Moderate.

items.q: What if a CAPTCHA or block shows up?
items.a: The circuit breaker pauses on its own (30s, 2min, 8min, 30min), notifies you in the panel and resumes one speed level below. We never insist against a block — insisting is what gets accounts burned.

items.q: My internet dropped mid-search. Did I lose everything?
items.a: No. The queue lives in IndexedDB in the browser and every cell is persisted server-side. When you're back online, the search resumes exactly where it stopped.

items.q: How does the “no website” filter work?
items.a: Every lead is classified server-side: no website = HOT; social-only presence (Facebook, Instagram, linktr.ee, wa.me) = WARM; own domain = COLD. The 0–100 heat_score cross-references that with rating, review count, phone and valid WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
items.a: Any time, no lock-in. Credits from the current cycle stay available until it ends, and you can export everything to CSV/XLSX before leaving.

content.aboutBluf: Bottom line up front: Play Google Scraper is a Brazilian B2B prospecting platform that turns Google Maps into a prioritized work queue — real-browser extraction, digital-presence scoring and a compliant outreach pipeline (LGPD/GDPR).
content.aboutMissionText: Give small sales teams the prospecting power that used to belong only to large data operations: full regional coverage, smart prioritization and human contact at the right moment — without depending on bought, outdated lists.
content.aboutHowText: We are 100% subscription: monthly/annual plans in BRL that include extraction credits and seats. We do not sell lead lists, do not resell data and do not monetize our customers' data — your tenant's leads are yours, with export and deletion available.
aboutEngineeringList: Payload→DOM→detail cascade extraction engine with per-field type validation and per-strategy telemetry — decisions documented in public ADRs.
Quadtree grid search (~3 km cells, depth 4) that beats the ~120-result ceiling of a single Google Maps query.
Log-normal humanization (Box-Muller) and exponential circuit breaker — long-running operations without a blocking spiral.
Multi-tenant isolation proven by a per-table verification suite (tenant_id on 100% of business tables).
Idempotent API v1 (Idempotency-Key) with pgs_live_ tokens (SHA-256, scopes, revocation) and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks.
aboutTrustList: API tokens shown once; only SHA-256 stored server-side; immediate revocation and last-use tracking.
Keyword-based opt-out on WhatsApp replies with per-tenant permanent suppression, enforced server-side before every send.
CSV export and lead deletion available in the UI — data subject rights (art. 18 LGPD) operational, not promises.
Audit trail of every lead and member operation, with a dedicated panel page.
Security headers (HSTS, CSP, anti-clickjacking) applied on all public pages.
content.aboutWhoText: Digital agencies, web designers, consultancies, real estate agencies, clinics, gyms and sales teams prospecting local businesses. Not for extracting sensitive data or any use without a legal basis under data protection law.
content.aboutContactText: Support and privacy channel inside the panel (owner/admin team) and via institutional email. Response within 1 business day.
content.quickTitle: Quick summary: what is Play Google Scraper?
content.quickSubtitle: Direct answers to who this product is for and what it does.

quickItems.a: A multi-tenant SaaS platform with a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that extracts leads from Google Maps — name, phone, website, rating, reviews, address and categories — and turns them into a sales funnel with Kanban and WhatsApp.

quickItems.q: How does it get more than ~120 results per search?
quickItems.a: Through quadtree grid search: the region is split into ~3 km cells searched one by one; when a cell hits the limit it is subdivided into four (up to depth 4), covering 100% of the area instead of a truncated sample.

quickItems.q: What is the heat score and what is it for?
quickItems.a: A 0–100 score computed on the server that prioritizes leads by digital presence: businesses without a website are the hottest (+35), followed by social-only pages (+18), plus rating, reviews, phone, WhatsApp and category signals.

quickItems.q: How does messaging comply with privacy law (LGPD)?
quickItems.a: Every WhatsApp campaign has keyword opt-out ('stop') with permanent per-tenant suppression enforced server-side before each send, time windows, daily limits and number warm-up — plus a complete audit trail.
